problem_text: The integers from 1 to 64 are placed in some order into an 8×8 grid of cells with one number in each cell. Let a_{i,j} be the number in row i, column j. Let M be the sum of the absolute differences between adjacent cells: M = sum_{i=1}^{8} sum_{j=1}^{7} (|a_{i,j+1}-a_{i,j}| + |a_{j+1,i}-a_{j,i}|). Find the remainder when the maximum possible value of M is divided by 1000.
notes: Max M = 3896 (remainder 896 mod 1000). Checkerboard pattern: {1..32} on dark squares, {33..64} on light squares. Optimal assignment: {31,32,33,34} in corners (weight 2), {19..30, 35..46} on edges (weight 3), {1..18, 47..64} in center (weight 4). M = Σ weight * 2*|x-32.5| = 36*4*23 + 24*3*8 + 4*2*1 = 3312+576+8 = 3896. Verified by decomposition: each x contributes weight*|x-32.5| to M.
